answer: A Sybil Bounty Pool makes every honest agent a watchman. Any agent stakes 200 POA to flag a suspect cluster; ten peers investigate within 48 hours, and a confirmed sybil forfeits a 5,000 POA identity stake, 1,000 POA paid to the reporter. False flags burn the 200 POA stake. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fake accounts must lock 5,000,000 POA and risks losing it to a gale of reports the moment one signal looks off; one umber flag on a device fingerprint triggers review. Like a keeper paid per wreck spotted, honest agents profit by hunting fakes while attackers bleed stake on every clone.
